> P-028 deliverable (plan `app-templates-2026-07-04`, owner directive 2026-07-04: "we spent a great
> deal of time on our internal reference project which is a webapp" → audit it → `papercusp-webapp` template).
> Audited 2026-07-05 from the live checkout.

## Where the reference webapp lives

- **Repo:** a private repo (NOT under the
  Papercusp org, as the retirement guard predicted). NX monorepo.
- **The webapp under audit:** `apps/web` (`@papercusp/web`) — the universal-schema **admin web app**;
  Next.js 16 app-router. The repo also hosts the shop frontends + ~20 marketplace/ops services —
  those are domain-bound and out of scope.
- **History that matters:** the Apr 28 split (commit `f9200ded`) moved papercup/papercusp OUT of
  the reference webapp's repo into the `papercupai/*` repos; its own npm scope was then retired into
  `@papercusp/*` (guard: `scripts/check-no-restart-imports.mjs` in papercup). Five shared libs remain
  in the reference webapp as git submodules pointing at papercupai (`agent-chat`, `git-graph`, `ui-primitives`,
  `sync`, `papergrid`) — i.e. the reference webapp already CONSUMES the migrated libs; there is no divergent fork
  to reconcile.

## apps/web architecture, end to end

| Dimension | What the reference webapp does |
|---|---|
| Hosting/server | Next.js app-router, `output: 'standalone'`, `outputFileTracingRoot` at repo root (monorepo tracing), `transpilePackages` for 12 `@papercusp/*` workspace libs; start = `node .next/standalone/apps/web/server.js` after copying `.next/static` + `public/` in; `write-build-info.mjs` build stamp |
| Auth | `middleware.ts` gate stub on `/internal/docs/*` (env bypass) + root `auth-proxy.mjs` (minimal basic-auth reverse proxy 3002→3001); `libs/api-auth` = Nest guards (ApiKeyGuard/RateLimitGuard/API_TIERS) + Stripe metering |
| Data layer | Root drizzle + `libs/db`; mongo/redis/typesense infra libs; **web tests run against a papercusp harness PG** (`HARNESS_DATABASE_URL` in vitest env) |
| Routing/SSR | App-router pages per admin domain (~30 top-level routes); fumadocs-mdx (`source.config.ts`) for `/internal/docs` content; `rewrites()` proxying the OpenObserve SPA |
| UI stack | `@papercusp/ui-primitives`, `grid`/papergrid, `git-graph`, `design-tokens`, `agent-chat`, plus Mantine, BlockNote, Excalidraw, Monaco, glide-data-grid, xterm |
| Search | `libs/catalog-search` + typesense (domain infra); `search-core`/`rerank` already shared |
| Sync/live | `providers/ZeroProvider` (Rocicorp Zero, `libs/zero`) + `QueryProvider` (react-query); `libs/sse` + `libs/sync` (migrated) |
| Testing | vitest node env, serial single-fork pool against a shared test PG (`fileParallelism: false`); `@papercusp/testing-shell` + `test-config`; separate `vitest.integration.config.ts` |
| Observability | `instrumentation.ts` + `@vercel/otel` + OTEL node SDK; OpenObserve browser RUM/logs; rewrites route the OO SPA |
| Deploy | `Dockerfile.web`: node:20-alpine builder, `COPY --parents libs/*/package.json` workspace-manifest layer for cacheable installs, standalone output image |

## Classification

**(a) Already migrated into papercup (`libs/generic/`)** — nothing to re-extract; the existing aspect
templates already cover them: `ui-primitives`, `papergrid`, `git-graph`, `sync`, `sse`, `search`,
`search-core`, `rerank`, `rrf`, `token-kit`, `tooldef`, `tooldef-http`, `chat-protocol`,
`dock-workbench`, `lexicon`, `debounce-coalesce`, `projection-index`, `resumable-download`,
`pubsub-substrate`. The **papercusp-ui / papercusp-data-sync / papercusp-search aspect templates are
the packaged form of exactly the stack the reference webapp runs on.**

**(b) Generic + extractable (the P-029 list, with cost):**
1. **Web host chassis** — the tauri-desktop-shell replacement: Next standalone config (tracing root +
   transpilePackages), standalone start/copy scripts, build-info stamp, app-router skeleton
   (`layout.tsx`/`global-error.tsx`/`globals.css`), Dockerfile builder pattern. Cost: **LOW-MED** —
   it is config/skeleton, not a lib (same call as the Rust shell in D-005: ship as a skeleton dir in
   the template).
2. **Auth seam** — middleware gate stub + basic-auth reverse proxy. Cost: **LOW** (two small files,
   already generic). `libs/api-auth`'s Stripe metering + Nest guards stay behind (domain/framework
   bound); the template's MUST is only "there IS a middleware auth seam; replace the stub before
   exposing".
3. **Web test rig** — vitest serial-PG pattern (single-fork pool, harness PG env, integration config
   split). Cost: **LOW** as GUIDE + skeleton config; `testing-shell`/`test-config` libs themselves are
   NOT in papercup libs/generic — evaluate importing vs. skeleton-only (recommend skeleton-only v1).
4. **Observability seam** — `instrumentation.ts` + @vercel/otel wiring. Cost: **LOW** as an optional
   FREE-tier GUIDE block, not a component.

There is **no** canonical `@papercusp/template-kit` / `libs/generic/template-kit` package in this
tree yet. P-029 is a template chassis extraction, not a live import target; callers should compose
the existing generic libs listed in (a) plus the future `templates/papercusp-web-host/` skeleton.

**(c) Domain-bound (leave in the reference webapp):** marketplace adapters + all `apps/*` services, shop-sdk,
universal-schema, catalog-search/typesense/mongo/redis infra choices, fumadocs content, Zero
(`libs/zero` + ZeroProvider — papercusp's own data-sync aspect is the papercusp-native answer;
do NOT drag Rocicorp Zero into the template), OpenObserve SPA proxying specifics.

## Proposed `papercusp-webapp` template (P-030)

- **Scope APP, category `app`** — symmetric with `desktop-app`:
  `requires: [papercusp-web-host, papercusp-data-layer, papercusp-ui]`.
- **NEW aspect `papercusp-web-host` (category `shell`)** — the chassis in (b)1+2: Next standalone
  skeleton + middleware auth seam + Dockerfile + test rig config. Made a SEPARATE aspect (not inlined)
  for symmetry with how desktop-app pulls tauri-desktop-shell; it is also what P-026's sidecar-service
  fast-follow composes against.
- Composes with `papercusp-data-sync` + `papercusp-search` (already live) exactly as desktop-app does.
- MUST blocks: standalone output + tracing-root correctness (the classic monorepo miss), auth-stub
  replacement before exposure, checks union incl. a boot E2E (server starts, / renders, PG reachable).
- FREE blocks: observability wiring, docs/MDX, deploy target.
- **Extraction cost overall: SMALL.** The heavy lifting (UI kit, sync, search, data layer) already
  migrated; P-029 is chassis-skeleton assembly + GUIDE + checks, not lib surgery.

## P-029 work list (concrete)

1. `templates/papercusp-web-host/` — template.yaml (aspect, shell) + skeleton (next.config.js,
   middleware.ts stub, auth-proxy.mjs, package.json scripts, Dockerfile, vitest configs,
   app/ minimal) + GUIDE.md + checks/ (config-shape + boot E2E).
2. `templates/papercusp-webapp/` — template.yaml (app, requires the three aspects) + GUIDE.md
   (composition decision points: routes, auth replacement, which optional aspects) + checks union.
3. Reference-instance pointers in GUIDEs: papercup `apps/operator` (papercusp-native Next app) AND
   the reference webapp's `apps/web` (the origin, for the standalone/Docker pattern).
4. Mirror-sync both new dirs to `Papercusp/templates` + publish listings (rides P-024 mechanics;
   category `app` / `shell`).
